The peace that Jesus gives to us, who accept Him, is not like the peace of this world. The world definition of peace is a lack of conflict or problems, but Jesus kind of peace is a peace in our soul even during times of conflict and problems. We receive God’s kind of peace when we are born again, as it is in the fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23) that we receive upon being born again. The way that we activate this peace is by keeping our minds upon the Lord, and He will keep us in perfect peace (Isaiah 26:3). Thank you Lord for giving us the Comforter and all our gifts of the Spirit.
